_doc.purpose: Benchmark profile for `node .ombutocode/src/headless.js run --profile benchmark`: removes every idle/cooldown source so the scheduler drains the backlog as fast as the agents allow. Applied in memory only — nothing here is persisted to headless-settings.json or codingagents.yml.

settings.run_summary_enabled: false = do not spend an extra agent run summarising each merged ticket's transcripts (the run-output logs are kept instead).
settings.app_refresh_interval: seconds between scheduler status/ETA refreshes and CLI progress lines (5 instead of the default 30).
settings.max_eval_retries: how many test/eval/merge failures a ticket may accumulate before the scheduler halts it (assignee → NONE). 2 matches the app default.

agents.cooldown_minutes: per-tool pause between runs from codingagents.yml. The current scheduler records but never enforces it; zeroed for completeness.
agents.rolling_window_hours: length of the usage-counting window. 0 falls back to the 5h default inside windowTracker, but the window no longer pauses pickup, so it has no scheduling effect either way.
agents.rate_limit_cooldown_minutes: fallback pause when an agent reports a rate limit without a reset time (default 60 min). 0 = do not pause at all.
agents.max_concurrent: implementation runs a tool may have in flight at once (test, eval and merge each get one extra dedicated slot).

scheduler.eval_post_merge_cooldown_ms: wait before the next eval dispatch after a squash-merge to main (default 15000 ms) so ticket branches can be rebased. 0 = dispatch immediately.
